answer: One pearl, one agent: each identity locks a pearl bond worth twice its 30-day reward, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 pearls. A beacon runs falcon-fast spot checks: each epoch it picks 5% at random and demands a compute heartbeat within 60 seconds. Miss twice, lose the pearl. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share; a sybil farm needs 1,000 pearls and machines to stay on the reef — $40,000 in bonds for a $2,000 pool, a certain loss.
